== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここから他のドッキング・ベイへの輸送には１フォース消費する。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここから他のドッキング・ベイへの輸送には３フォース消費する。ここへの輸送には＋４フォース余分に消費する。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. Transit from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force. Dark Side. Transit from here to another docking bay costs 3 Force. Transit to here costs 4 extra Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese omits English “Your”. Dark text says transit to here costs ＋４フォース余分に (4 extra Force). Title is エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ. One Light Force icon, no Dark Force icons.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothechodockingbay.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay]].</ref>
